result:
I planned round 448: the Hire-Us inquiry e-mail. The task is written and `b-next.json` says CONTINUE.

**Round 447:** C passed it with real browser checks and gate 447 published it as `cce5eda`, so STORE-2b-2a is marked done in the backlog and in `feature-status.md`. Round 448 starts from `cce5eda`. The old task is preserved as `tasks/round-447.md`, and the store tree is still clean.

**Scope change from the plan:**
- **`app/lib/email.server.ts` is dead code.** Nothing imports it; its only caller was removed with the Shopify code. I did not restyle it. It joins the dead-code cleanup list with `PianoCurtainLoader.tsx`, for removal in the next cleanup round under Saba's legacy policy.
- **The live e-mail has a real bug.** I rendered the e-mail the `/hire-us` form actually sends in Chromium:
  - In a light mail client, 10 of 12 text lines fail contrast.
  - The submitted name, project type and budget are white on white, so they are invisible.
  - Swapping teal for brass alone can't fix it (brass on white is 2.33:1).
  - I filed it as a Medium bug and the round fixes it together with the teal.

**Round 448 task:**
- **E-mail:** the template moves out of the route into a pure builder module. Its colours are an exact copy of the Store theme tokens, and a test fails if the two drift apart. A dark background is painted on an outer table so mail clients keep it.
- **Tests:** HE1–HE9, including an in-suite contrast check, plus two small Lows from round 447 (exact counts in the teal allow-list, and a `perf/` scan).
- **Sketch evidence:**
  - every one of the 10 deliberately broken versions fails its named test;
  - typecheck, lint and build pass, and the e-mail code stays out of the client bundle;
  - the full suite passes, 281 files and 4119 tests;
  - the e-mail has 0 contrast failures in light and dark clients (minimum 7.06:1);
  - the `/hire-us` page is pixel-identical to HEAD at 1440, 1280 and 375.
- **Review:** the tech-lead asked for changes on the first version and approved the second. That is the version dispatched.
- **C's checks:** 13 rows in a real browser: e-mail contrast and structure, escaping, page parity, a HEAD-vs-HEAD control for round 447's unexplained hero pixel difference, a re-measure of the showcase contrast, and Studio plus purchase protection. A real send can't run in the cloud, so it is BLOCKED and becomes a Tech Lead manual check (deadline RETRO 465).

**Loop tooling problem:** `sketch-server.sh` with a patch silently serves HEAD unchanged, because its `git apply` runs inside the loop folder's own git repo. Rounds 446–447 only used it without a patch, so C's past results are unaffected. I recorded it and told C to serve HEAD without a patch only.

**Decisions for Saba:**
- Should the Hire-Us e-mail be light (dark text on white) instead of the dark Store look? Dark ships unless he says otherwise.
- `.claude/primitives/DESIGN_TOKENS.md` still lists teal as the brand colour. I proposed updating it but did not edit it.

**For root:** `agent-workflow.md` on disk is only 87 lines and ends at the Loop v2 section, much shorter than the policy text in my prompt.

Remaining queue: STORE-2b-3 → 2b-4 → STORE-2c…5, then ARCH-SPLIT, REVIEW-RECOMMENDATIONS, T12-ADVANCED and the phase-2 queues. Regression is due on 2026-11-13 and RETRO is round 450. STEM-LANES is still waiting for Saba.

The advisor was available and I consulted it twice; its pre-hand-off check added three things that are now in the task: the page probe, the saved structure diff and a working HEAD capture recipe.
